content.short: Consumer banking and cash advance app.
content.description: Dave, founded in 2016, is a US consumer banking app best known for small, interest-free cash advances that help members cover expenses before payday and avoid overdraft fees. Alongside its ExtraCash advances, Dave offers a spending account and debit card, automated budgeting that predicts upcoming bills, savings features, and a side-gig marketplace to help users earn extra income. Working with a partner bank, it targets everyday Americans living paycheck to paycheck who are underserved by traditional banks and hurt by high overdraft charges. By combining short-term liquidity, banking, and financial-health tools in one app, Dave competes with other US neobanks focused on affordability and inclusion.
content.meta: Dave is a US banking app with fee-free cash advances, a debit card, and budgeting. Discover Dave and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
